whole_record_admission: Frozen bound writers preencode exactly one complete scientific row/update per PairedBudget.write_bytes call. An oversized record faults before opening; no dropped fields or truncation. Chunked path writes retain category/namespace bounds, not general JSON framing.

raw_capture.overflow_disposition: INCONCLUSIVE; preserve bounded prefix; disclose unread-tail uncertainty; join all writers before any valid seal
raw_capture.full_digest_or_length: Only when complete output was observed through EOF; otherwise unknown

compact_audit.representation: Canonical compact UTF-8 JSON; fixed scalar/hash/rational whitelists and fixed small arrays; no native vectors or full dyadic trial lists in verification. Complete native rows and raw optimizer journals preserve numerical witnesses. Oversized or unknown fields fail closed; never silently dropped or rounded.
compact_audit.preflight: Preencode and validate verification, candidate, freeze, report and closeout together before opening any final artifact. Check each cap, existing namespace sizes and complete final-category sum. Frozen Budget remains authoritative for actual writes, partial writes and sealing.

finalization.candidate_requires: 12/12 original behavioral acceptance and matching designated final replays; independent authenticated first-passing exact serialized descent audit; fault-free quiescent complete inventory; no added drift or near-optimality gate
finalization.native_candidate_norm: Actual serialized native endpoint satisfies the unchanged exact decimal net ball at most0.20; never renormalize or repair an endpoint
finalization.failure_precedence: Any sticky recording fault overrides every provisional scientific artifact, including zero-byte verification; no parse or promotion of failed verification, no repair or retry.

limitations: Cooperative authenticated Windows recording, not an operating-system sandbox; POSIX kernel locking remains unverified.
Caps bound admitted namespace file-content bytes, not guaranteed completion of arbitrary loader/error output or the1800s schedule.
Partial writes and registered temporary replacement overlap are counted; already-admitted reserved writes may finish during failure.
Unconfirmed quiescence or failed/hung I/O is INCONCLUSIVE/unsealed; failure receipts may be best-effort, never a valid candidate.
Raw log and diagnostic prefixes are explicit; unread tails and unknown full lengths/hashes are never called complete output.
RAM, OS buffers, filesystem metadata and external sync copies are outside namespace file-content accounting.
Prior final-artifact-cap failure stays immutable. New exact-source full-finalization preparation is required, separate from any later real-run authorization.
